"""Forward-dark port intervention and data-only rerouting between frozen ABA blocks. Run: python3 -m scripts.probe_dark_intermediate_port [--json] All native rows are exhaustive finite counts, never experimental data. Reading the middle of a stored microhistory inserts no detector or collapse into it. """ import argparse from dataclasses import dataclass from fractions import Fraction as F from itertools import product import json from scripts import probe_three_port_dark_bounds as echo from scripts import probe_vacuum_compensated_network as net from scripts.probe_eight_label_interferometer import check PORTS = range(3) SETTINGS = ("off", "A", "B", "C", "cycle") # Cell layout D,E,Z,scratch per port. A->B->C->A, using A's existing # scratch=1: move C out, then B->C, A->B, scratch->A. No E contact. CYCLE_WORD = (((8, 3),), ((4, 8),), ((0, 4),), ((3, 0),)) def history(source, stock, setting): """Launch, cut before intervention, cut after intervention, and exit.""" check(type(source) is int and source in PORTS and len(stock) == 3 and all(type(v) is int and v in net.SHADES for v in stock) and setting in SETTINGS, "unsupported launch or intervention") initial = tuple(v for i, e in enumerate(stock) for v in (3 if i == source else 1, e, 0, 1)) block = echo._physical_word() replay = net.mobile._replay # checks conservation after each individual contact middle = replay(initial, block).output wanted = list(middle) # independent endpoint check; never input to replay if setting == "off": word = () elif setting == "cycle": word = CYCLE_WORD wanted[0::4] = (middle[8], middle[0], middle[4]) else: i = 4 * "ABC".index(setting) word = (((i+2, i+1),),) # one real B(Z,E) with Z=0 at this cut wanted[i+1] = 3-middle[i+1] intervention = replay(middle, word) after = intervention.output check(after == tuple(wanted), "intervention changed untargeted stock or failed transport") final = replay(after, block).output for cut in (initial, middle, after, final): echo._raw_port(cut) # all 12 cells, including auxiliaries, not just D check(all(v in net.SHADES for v in cut[1::4]), "cut controller outside shade code") check(middle[1::4] == tuple(stock) and final[1::4] == after[1::4], "block changed cut stock") check(setting != "off" or final == initial, "unplated raw echo not restored") return initial, middle, after, final def native_census(): middle = [[0]*3 for _ in PORTS] exits = {s: [[0]*3 for _ in PORTS] for s in SETTINGS} for source, stock in product(PORTS, product(net.SHADES, repeat=3)): common = None for s in SETTINGS: _, cut, _, final = history(source, stock, s) if common is None: common = cut middle[source][echo._raw_port(cut)] += 1 check(common == cut, "launch condition depends on later setting") exits[s][source][echo._raw_port(final)] += 1 return tuple(map(tuple, middle)), {s: tuple(map(tuple, t)) for s, t in exits.items()} def cycle_controls(): """Independent named models; transparent port routing is supplied.""" permuted = [[0]*3 for _ in PORTS] for w, g in ((4, (0, 1, 2)), (2, (2, 1, 0)), (2, (0, 2, 1))): for i in PORTS: permuted[i][g[(g[i]+1) % 3]] += w # U P U with U a fixed real balanced Hadamard on AC or BC (fair # launch choice), identity on the spectator. Under this particular P # each (source,exit) has at most one nonzero amplitude path: signs # cannot interfere, so square path magnitudes exactly, without floats. coherent = [[F(0)]*3 for _ in PORTS] for pair in ((0, 2), (1, 2)): def h_squared(i, j): return F(1, 2) if i in pair and j in pair else F(i == j and i not in pair) for i, j in product(PORTS, repeat=2): paths = [h_squared(i, k)*h_squared((k+1) % 3, j) for k in PORTS] check(sum(x != 0 for x in paths) <= 1, "coherent path cross term neglected") coherent[i][j] += F(1, 2)*sum(paths) check(all((8*x).denominator == 1 for row in coherent for x in row), "nonintegral count") return {"fixed_permutation": tuple(map(tuple, permuted)), "fixed_coherent": tuple(tuple(int(8*x) for x in row) for row in coherent)} @dataclass(frozen=True) class Scope: same_preparation_at_cut: bool | None = None forward_q_bounds_full_active_weight: bool | None = None relative_unitary_identity_on_complement: bool | None = None common_subsequent_channel_and_event: bool | None = None all_launches_no_postselection: bool | None = None def interval_verdict(intervals, scope, model="supported_unitary"): """Conditional compatibility certificate, including mixed inputs/ancillas. P is the full active subspace, q=

before intervention. Compare OFF with a relative unitary V fixing its orthogonal complement pointwise; absorb the common evolution into the exit effect 0<=M<=I. On a purification psi (extend P,V,M by identity where necessary), ||sqrt(M)V psi|| <= ||sqrt(M)psi|| + ||(V-I)P psi|| <= sqrt(r)+2sqrt(q). This is a bound on unconditional event probabilities, not a weak value. For V=I-2P and r=0, sqrt(M)psi=0. Subtract the component of V psi along psi to get s<=1-||²=4q(1-q). Attainable at every q: psi=(sqrt(1-q),sqrt(q)), P projects onto coordinate two, M onto the orthogonal complement of psi. Not valid by substituting small r for zero. """ def verdict(reason, exclude=False): return {"excluded": exclude, "reason": reason} if (not isinstance(scope, Scope) or not all(v is True for v in vars(scope).values()) or model not in ("supported_unitary", "scalar_pi")): return verdict("inconclusive: comparator scope not established") if not isinstance(intervals, dict) or set(intervals) != {"q", "r", "s"}: return verdict("inconclusive: simultaneous bounds on q, r and s required") for v in intervals.values(): if (not isinstance(v, (list, tuple)) or len(v) != 2 or not all(type(x) in (int, F) and 0 <= x <= 1 for x in v) or v[0] > v[1]): return verdict("inconclusive: invalid exact probability interval") q0, q1 = intervals["q"] r, s = intervals["r"][1], intervals["s"][0] excess = s-r-4*q1 if excess > 0 and excess**2 > 16*r*q1: return verdict("violates supported-unitary triangle bound", True) if model == "scalar_pi" and r == 0: peak = min(q1, max(q0, F(1, 2))) if s > 4*peak*(1-peak): return verdict("violates scalar-pi exact-dark bound", True) return verdict("inconclusive: necessary bound not violated") def verify(): middle, exits = native_census() controls = cycle_controls() check(middle == ((6, 0, 2), (0, 6, 2), (2, 2, 4)), "forward cut population") check(exits["off"] == ((8, 0, 0), (0, 8, 0), (0, 0, 8)), "echo") check(exits["A"] == ((4, 2, 2), (2, 4, 2), (2, 2, 4)), "A controller") check(exits["B"] == exits["C"] == ((4, 0, 4), (0, 4, 4), (4, 4, 0)), "held-out controllers") check(exits["cycle"] == controls["fixed_permutation"] == ((0, 4, 4), (4, 0, 4), (4, 4, 0)), "native cycle or fixed-permutation alias") check(controls["fixed_coherent"] == ((1, 4, 3), (4, 1, 3), (3, 3, 2)), "named coherent cycle") scope = Scope(True, True, True, True, True) # IF the common operational identification is supplied b_events = {} for name, ports in (("A_exit", (0,)), ("non_B_exit", (0, 2))): q = F(middle[1][0], 8) r, s = (F(sum(exits[k][1][j] for j in ports), 8) for k in ("off", "A")) values = {"q": q, "r": r, "s": s} check(interval_verdict({k: (x, x) for k, x in values.items()}, scope)["excluded"], "conditional forward-dark discriminator missing") b_events[name] = {k: str(x) for k, x in values.items()} # A simultaneous uncertainty box, not measured counts or an inferred # confidence interval. Choose root bounds rationally for an exact example. root_q = root_r = F(1, 8) s_lower = F(1, 4) demo = interval_verdict({"q": (0, root_q**2), "r": (0, root_r**2), "s": (s_lower, 1)}, scope) return { "middle_over_8": middle, "exit_over_8": exits, "cycle_comparator_over_8": controls, "B_launch": b_events, "hypothetical_simultaneous_bounds": { "q_upper": str(root_q**2), "r_upper": str(root_r**2), "s_lower": str(s_lower), "allowed_s_upper": str((root_r+2*root_q)**2), "excluded_under_scope": demo["excluded"]}, "comparator_bound": "sqrt(s) <= sqrt(r) + 2 sqrt(q), also for mixed inputs/ancillas. " "If OFF is exactly event-dark and the relative operation is I-2P, " "s <= 4q(1-q), sharp at each actual q.", "scope": "Finite classical histories, eight equally weighted stocks per source; no empirical data. " "Rows are sources; columns detected ports. q is forward cut population over all launches.", "boundary": "The native plate flips E even on a token-empty port. A programmed controller change " "is not a pure path phase. Exclusion requires the measured q to bound the entire active " "subspace, a common cut preparation, supported unitary without cross-talk, common " "subsequent evolution/detection and no postselection; these are not derived. " "Data-only transparent rerouting distinguishes the named coherent device, not all " "coherent models; the frozen permutation mixture still aliases the native cycle."} if __name__ == "__main__": parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__) parser.add_argument("--json", action="store_true") args = parser.parse_args() report = verify() print(json.dumps(report, indent=2) if args.json else f"B launch: {report['B_launch']}. {report['boundary']}")
